---
name: story-from-notes
description: Turns meeting notes, workshop notes, or raw requirement lists into user stories with open questions and an out-of-scope list. Use when asked to write user stories from notes, minutes, or a requirements draft.
---
# User stories from notes

## Steps
1. Read the notes. List every goal a person wants to reach.
2. Group the goals by role (customer, support agent, compliance officer, ...).
3. Write one story per goal. Format: As a <role>, I want <goal>, so that <benefit>.
4. Give each story an ID: US-001, US-002, ... If the target file has stories already, continue from the highest ID.
5. Put items marked "not now", "later", or "nice to have" into a section "Out of scope".
6. Put every unanswered question into a section "Open questions". Do not answer them yourself.
7. Follow the [example story](../../../samples/user-story-example.md).

## Rules
- One story = one goal.
- No technical solution in the story.
- Keep the name of the person who raised a point, in brackets, after the story. Example: (Marc, compliance)
